caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with a backrest and armrests positioned on each end. The bench is constructed from light brown wood, showing visible grain patterns and knots. The seat and backrest are made of solid, narrow planks, while the supporting framework consists of thicker, square wooden legs and rails. The bench stands on a section of ground covered with irregularly shaped, reddish-brown stone tiles that form a loosely arranged pattern. The background is plain and uncolored, with no additional objects or details present. The artist’s signature, “R.G.F. MILLER,” appears in small capital letters below and slightly to the right of the bench.
title: Mission Bench
